SCREENS.PRIMARY_EDITORIAL_GESTURE: Classical marble bust low at the right, with an oxblood textile on its plinth.
SCREENS.SECONDARY_TACTILE_DETAIL: Olive branch from the upper right and a torn plaster edge. A separate paper scrap was left out so the lounge stays one gesture.
SCREENS.WHY_NEW_PLATE: The lounge, bust, and burgundy textile are this page's room. No earlier ENTRY v2 plate existed, and no other page in this batch uses that room.

SCREENS.PRIMARY_EDITORIAL_GESTURE: One oversized manifesto on a single torn cotton sheet.
SCREENS.SECONDARY_TACTILE_DETAIL: A small engraved column print at the upper right of the sheet.
SCREENS.WHY_NEW_PLATE: The page is a print spread, not the welcome lounge. The blank sheet plus the column print is its own substrate.

SCREENS.PRIMARY_EDITORIAL_GESTURE: Four overlapping deckled strips as one folio spread.
SCREENS.SECONDARY_TACTILE_DETAIL: One botanical olive print at the left, with a narrow oxblood edge on one strip.
SCREENS.WHY_NEW_PLATE: A stone-desk still life of strips is not the manifesto sheet. Reusing the value plate would drop the spread.

SCREENS.PRIMARY_EDITORIAL_GESTURE: A folded ivory invitation standing on a travertine table.
SCREENS.SECONDARY_TACTILE_DETAIL: An olive sprig on the table. The room is an arched loggia, not the welcome lounge.
SCREENS.WHY_NEW_PLATE: The loggia, stairs, and tent card are a different setting from Welcome. The welcome plate cannot hold this invitation.

SCREENS.PRIMARY_EDITORIAL_GESTURE: One full-height deckled registration sheet on plaster.
SCREENS.SECONDARY_TACTILE_DETAIL: An olive branch at the right edge.
SCREENS.WHY_NEW_PLATE: The form needs this tall sheet. Sign In uses a smaller card on a ledge, so the two do not share a plate.

SCREENS.PRIMARY_EDITORIAL_GESTURE: An open ivory envelope with a letter drawn out.
SCREENS.SECONDARY_TACTILE_DETAIL: An embossed olive-leaf seal and one torn sheet at the left.
SCREENS.WHY_NEW_PLATE: The correspondence still life is its own object. No other page in this batch uses the envelope.

SCREENS.PRIMARY_EDITORIAL_GESTURE: A quiet credential card standing on a stone ledge.
SCREENS.SECONDARY_TACTILE_DETAIL: Olive shadow from the upper left and a stone bowl in the foreground.
SCREENS.WHY_NEW_PLATE: Same paper family as Create Account, different object and camera. Reusing the tall registration sheet would flatten this ledge.
